title: Election Results | Voting & Election Information | Commonwealth of Pennsylvania
contextLines: While we know there may be a rush to predict the outcomes, counties are prioritizing accuracy and security above all else as they count ballots. We want Pennsylvania voters to know that their votes will be accurately counted and verified. Results of some races may not be known on election night.
The results of federal and state elections in Pennsylvania are available on the election results website starting after 8 p.m. on election night.
